# Morocco Quest

> Morocco Quest is a licensed Moroccan travel agency based in Marrakech. We offer private Morocco tours, Sahara desert tours, small group tours, luxury desert camps, and tailor-made multi-day tour packages operated by expert local guides.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://morocco-quest.com/): Overview of all Morocco tours, packages, and the agency
- [All Tours](https://morocco-quest.com/tours): Browse all private and group Morocco tour packages
- [Multi-Day Trips](https://morocco-quest.com/trips): 3, 5, and 7-day Morocco tour itineraries including Sahara desert
- [Destinations](https://morocco-quest.com/destinations): Morocco tour destinations — Marrakech, Fes, Sahara, Atlas Mountains
- [Activities](https://morocco-quest.com/activities): Morocco day trips and activities by category
- [Activity Categories](https://morocco-quest.com/activity-categories): Browse activities by type
- [Blog](https://morocco-quest.com/blog): Morocco travel guide, tips, and itinerary advice
- [FAQ](https://morocco-quest.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about Morocco tours, booking, visas, and safety
- [About](https://morocco-quest.com/about): About Morocco Quest travel agency and our local team
- [Contact](https://morocco-quest.com/contact): Contact Morocco Quest to book or inquire about tours
- [DMC Marrakech](https://morocco-quest.com/dmc-marrakech): Destination Management Company services in Marrakech
- [Multi-Day Tours](https://morocco-quest.com/tours/type/multi-day): All multi-day Morocco tours
- [One-Day Tours](https://morocco-quest.com/tours/type/one-day): All one-day Morocco tours and day trips

## About the Agency

- [Morocco Quest on TripAdvisor](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g293734-d33367694-Reviews-Morocco_Quest_Dmc-Marrakech_Marrakech_Safi.html): Reviews and ratings for Morocco Quest DMC

Agency name: Morocco Quest (also known as Morocco Quest DMC). Located in Marrakech, Morocco. Phone: +212-654-069-718. Languages: English, French, Spanish. Specialties: private Sahara desert tours, Marrakech to Merzouga tours, Atlas Mountains trekking, Fes cultural tours, luxury riad stays, camel trekking, Aït Benhaddou visits.

## Content Notes

All tour descriptions include departure city context, duration, itinerary highlights, pricing in USD/EUR, and inclusions. Blog posts cover practical Morocco travel advice written by local guides. The site is in English and targets travelers from the US, UK, France, Spain, and EU countries.
